- No PowerPoint or Board-materials evidence on your CV
- No consumption-based software model or AI tool experience

**Recommendation:** Apply now, and in your cover letter highlight your Power BI and forecasting work while noting a quick Pigment and PowerPoint upskill.

coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

A forecast is only useful if the people running the business trust it. At Calder Industrial Components, the larger of my two business units had a forecast accuracy of 88%, so I rebuilt the model around order backlog and brought it to 96%. Your R&D Finance team faces the same challenge: giving Engineering and Product leaders numbers they can plan against.

As a Financial Analyst with 5 years of experience in budgeting, forecasting and month-end reporting, I own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units with combined revenue of about 85 million USD. I also automated journal checks in Excel VBA, which cut month-end close reporting from 9 working days to 6, and I build Power BI dashboards on SAP data for plant managers. That is the kind of financial modeling and complex data work your team does when it helps create the annual budget and manages departmental budgets with senior leaders. Pigment, Tableau and Metabase are new to me, but I've picked up BI tools quickly, and I hold a B.S. in Finance and have passed 9 of 13 ACCA papers.

I'd welcome a conversation about how I can support your R&D Finance team and the leaders it partners with. I'm available to talk at your convenience and can work in the New York office three days a week.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt

applicationEmail.subject: Application: FP&A Analyst, Tomas Brandt
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Datadog Hiring Team,

I've spent 5 years in budgeting, forecasting and month-end reporting, and I currently own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units at Calder Industrial Components, which is the kind of partnership with budget owners your FP&A role needs. I rebuilt our forecast model around order backlog and automated reporting checks in Excel VBA, so I'm comfortable with financial modeling and complex data. My CV and cover letter are attached for you to look through. I'm available for a conversation any weekday and can start after a one-month notice period.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt
